与旅行一起成长(Growing up with travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:伊娃的经历、感受与成长。

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Eva wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Best of all, his season ticket covers all zones.

On Monday evenings, Eva reviews the notes from class. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. People around Eva often share different ideas about the travel plan. In fact, westerners eat noodles with a fork.

The bus stop has become an important part of daily life. At first, Eva found it difficult to keep the habit. Eva keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. Also, good music makes the long bus ride bearable.
Eva thanked Grace for the honest advice. Eva's dream job is to be a driver. Eva will take part in a football match in May. In fact, he spoke with the righteousness of a true believer.
Little by little, things began to change. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The experience taught Eva more than any book could.
